english_gloss: What is the recipient's phone number?
current_twi: Dɛn ne ne fono nomba no?

english_gloss: Any reference or note for this transfer? Say it, or say skip.
current_twi: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu bi wɔ hɔ ama saa som yi? Ka skip sɛ ɛnnhia.
Wo sika a ɛwɔ mu ne
Fa wo nsa nkyerɛwde so ahu gye to mu

english_gloss: Contacts are not allowed, so say their phone number.
current_twi: Contacts nni kwan, enti ka ne fono nomba.

english_gloss: I found more than one person with that name.
current_twi: Ahu nnipa pii a wɔ din no.

english_gloss: I don't know that name. Say their phone number instead.
current_twi: Menim din no. Ka ne fono nomba.

english_gloss: What is their mobile money number? Say it digit by digit.
current_twi: Dɛn ne ne fono nomba? Ka no mmienu mmienu.

english_gloss: Say the number of the person you want.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Please try again.
current_twi: Mepa kyɛw, mantee. Yɛwɔ mmɔdemmɔ bio.

english_gloss: You can say: my balance, statement, send money, airtime, cash out, home, repeat, or stop.
current_twi: Gye wo tom. Wobɛtumi aka: Me sika, Sika krataa, Kɔma sika, Tɔ airtime, Yi sika, Fie, San ka bio, anaagyɛ Gyae.
Wo nne na ɛgye to mu.

english_gloss: No fingerprint is set up, so your voice confirmation will be used.
current_twi: Nsa nkyerɛwde nnihɔ, enti wo nne na ɛgye to mu.

english_gloss: I didn't catch a command. Say my balance, or go home.
current_twi: Mante ahyɛdeɛ no aseɛ. Ka Me sika anaa Fie bio.

english_gloss: Say yes to confirm this recipient, or no to choose again.
current_twi: Ka aane gye nipa no to mu, anaagyɛ dabi san paw bio.

english_gloss: Say yes to confirm, or no to cancel.
current_twi: Ka aane gyee to mu, anaagyɛ dabi gya no.

english_gloss: For yourself, or for someone else?
Who are you sending money to?
Please enter a valid airtime amount greater than 0
current_twi: Hyɛ sika dodoɔ a ɛsen zero gu mu

english_gloss: Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number
current_twi: Hyɛ Ghana fono nɔma pa gu mu
Hyɛ wɛnda no nɔma nson gu mu
Hyɛ sika dodoɔ a ɛfata gu mu
Sika a ɛwɔ mu no asuma

english_gloss: SafePay confirms every payment with your fingerprint. Your PIN is never spoken.
current_twi: SafePay gye dwuma biara to mu de wo nsa nkyerɛwde. Wo PIN rennsɛ da.

english_gloss: The fingerprint did not match. You can try again any time.
current_twi: Nsa nkyerɛwde no annye to mu. Bɔ mmɔden bio bere biara.

english_gloss: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
This phone has no fingerprint sensor. SafePay will use your voice confirmation instead.
current_twi: Wo fono yi nnisa nkyerɛwde nnihɔ. SafePay de wo nne bɛgye to mu.

english_gloss: No fingerprint is enrolled yet. You can add one in your phone settings, under Security. SafePay will use your voice confirmation until then.
current_twi: Wonsa nkyerɛwde nnsi hɔ dada. Fa ka ho wɔ wo fono settings, Security ase. SafePay bɛde wo nne agye tomu kɔsi ɛno.

english_gloss: Your fingerprint is set up and ready.
Fingerprint confirmed. Your payments are protected.
current_twi: Nsa nkyerɛwde no agye to mu. Wo sika ho ban yɛ den.

english_gloss: Contacts allowed. SafePay can find your people by name.
current_twi: Contacts agye tom. SafePay betumi ahu wo nkurɔfoɔ wɔ din mu.

english_gloss: Later, SafePay can find a number when you say a name, for example send money to Ama. When you first use it, SafePay will ask for permission. Your contacts stay on your phone.
current_twi: Akyire yi, sɛ woka din te sɛ Ama a, SafePay betumi ahunu ne fono nomba. Nea edi kan no, ɛbɛbisa wo kwan. Wo contacts da wo fono mu pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_gloss: No problem. You can say phone numbers instead, or allow contacts later in Settings.
current_twi: Ɛnnɛ nnyɛ hwee. Wobɛtumi aka fono nomba, anaagyɛ agye contacts atom akyire wɔ Settings mu.

english_gloss: SafePay is ready. Your balance and your transactions can be read aloud, and your PIN is never spoken. Say me sika a aka to hear your balance.
current_twi: SafePay asiesie. Wobɛtumi ate wo sika ne wo dwuma nyinaa, na wo PIN rennsɛ da. Ka me sika a aka, na wote wo sika.

english_gloss: Setup paused. You can run it again from Settings.
current_twi: Nhyehyɛeɛ no agyae. San fi aseɛ wɔ Settings mu.

english_gloss: While SafePay is open, the microphone stays on. You never have to find a button. Say gyae, or stop, any time you want SafePay to be quiet.
current_twi: Bere a SafePay rebue no, microphone no da so. Ɛnsɛ sɛ wuhu bɔtɔn bi. Ka gyae anaagyɛ stop, na SafePay abu so.

english_gloss: May SafePay use the microphone? It listens while the app is open, so you can speak your commands.
current_twi: Microphone no ho akwannya? SafePay te nne bere a app no rebue, enti wobɛtumi aka wo ahyɛdeɛ.

english_gloss: No problem. You can allow the microphone later in Settings.
current_twi: Ɛnnɛ nnyɛ hwee. Akyire yi wubɛtumi agye tom wɔ Settings mu.

english_gloss: The microphone is allowed. SafePay can hear your commands.
current_twi: Microphone no agye tom. SafePay betumi ate wo nne.

english_gloss: The microphone is turned off for SafePay. Allow it in your phone settings, then open SafePay again.
current_twi: Wɔatow microphone no agu SafePay. Bu no mu wɔ wo fono settings mu, na san bue SafePay.

english_gloss: Now say anything. For example: hello SafePay.
current_twi: Sɛ wo nne. Sɛ nhwɛso: SafePay, ɛte sɛn?

english_gloss: I did not hear anything. Say it again, a little louder.
current_twi: Mantie hwee. Ka bio, yɛ den kakra.

english_gloss: Your screen reader is off. SafePay will speak for itself.
current_twi: Wo screen reader no aso. SafePay bɛka ne ho.
Wo screen reader no resi so.

english_gloss: How do you want to move around the screen?
current_twi: Sɛn na wupɛ sɛ wodwo krataafa no so?

english_gloss: Try again. The commands are: me sika a aka, kɔma sika, gyae.
current_twi: Bɔ mmɔden bio. Ahyɛdeɛ no ne: me sika a aka, kɔma sika, gyae.

english_gloss: Yes. Me sika a aka is the balance command.
current_twi: Ɛyɛ! Me sika a aka ne sika a ɛwɔ mu ahyɛdeɛ.

english_gloss: Three commands. Say: me sika a aka, to hear your balance. Say: kɔma sika, to send money. Say: gyae, to stop SafePay.
current_twi: Ahyɛdeɛ mmiɛnsa. Ka: me sika a aka, na wote wo sika. Ka: kɔma sika, na wokɔma sika. Ka: gyae, na SafePay abu so.

english_gloss: Yes. Kɔma sika is the send money command.
current_twi: Ɛyɛ! Kɔma sika ne sika a wokɔma no ahyɛdeɛ.

english_gloss: Turn the volume up, and listen again.
current_twi: Yɛ nne no den, na tie bio.

english_gloss: Good. You can change the volume at any time.
current_twi: Ɛyɛ. Wobɛtumi asesa nne so bere biara.

english_gloss: Welcome to SafePay. You are on the home screen. Double tap Speak Balance to hear your balance, or use the MoMo Services tiles to send money, hear your statement, buy airtime, or cash out.
current_twi: Akwaaba wɔ SafePay. Wowɔ fie krataafa so. Pia Speak Balance mpɛn mmienu na wote w’akaunt mu sika, anaa fa MoMo adwuma no di dwuma.

english_gloss: Welcome to SafePay. SafePay reads your money out loud, and your secret PIN is never spoken. This short setup works by voice and by touch.
current_twi: Akwaaba. SafePay ma wote wo sika, na wo PIN rennsɛ da. Nhyehyɛeɛ yi ti kakra. Fa wo nne anaa wo nsa yɛ.
Kasa bɛba asotwe mu nko ara
Wosowoso bɛyɛ adwuma wɔ bagua mu

english_gloss: Fingerprint check cancelled. The transaction was not completed.
current_twi: Wogyaae nsa nkyerɛwde no ahu no. Sika no nkɔ.

english_gloss: Fingerprint did not match. Please try again.
current_twi: Nsa nkyerɛwde no nyɛ wo dea. Yɛw bio.

english_gloss: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment before trying again.
current_twi: Wo yɛ no dodoɔ. Twɛn kakra na san yɛ bio.

english_gloss: Transaction cancelled. No money was sent.
Enter an amount greater than zero
current_twi: Hyɛ dodoɔ a ɛsen zero no ma

english_gloss: Enter a valid Ghana mobile number, for example 0241234567
current_twi: Hyɛ Ghana fono nɔma pa ma, sɛ 0241234567

english_gloss: Not enough balance in your wallet.
current_twi: Wo sika nnyi papa mu. Hwɛ wo balance.

english_gloss: Something went wrong. Please try again.

current_twi: Ntam a ɛnni ho. Yɛw bio.
Kwan a yɛfa so kɔ ne ba (WCAG 2.2)

english_gloss: SafePay voice check. Your balance and your transactions can be read aloud at any time.
current_twi: SafePay nne nhwɛsodeɛ. Wobɛtumi ate w’akaunt mu sika ne nsɛm bere biara.
Sika krataa kenkan no awie pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_gloss: Voice commands are not available right now.
You can say: balance, statement, send money, airtime, cash out, settings, repeat, or stop.
current_twi: Wobɛtumi aka: balance, statement, send money, airtime, cash out, settings, repeat, anaa stop.

english_gloss: I did not hear anything. Tap the microphone and speak.
current_twi: Mante hwee. Pia microphone no na kasa.

english_gloss: Voice commands are not available on this phone.
current_twi: Nne ahyɛde nni saa fon yi so.

english_gloss: I did not hear anything. Tap the microphone and speak.
current_twi: Mante hwee. Pia microphone no na kasa.

english_gloss: There is nothing to repeat yet.
current_twi: Hwee nni hɔ a mɛbɛka bio.

english_gloss: Microphone access is needed for voice commands. You can allow it in your phone settings.
current_twi: Wɔhia microphone kwan ma nne ahyɛde. Wobɛtumi ama kwan wɔ wo fon setting mu.
